message.reasoning_content:
The user wants me to convert an image of a document into HTML. The document is in Chinese and appears to be a management notes document about "员工访谈怎么聊" (How to conduct employee interviews).

Let me analyze the layout:
- Title at top: "Management Notes" and "员工访谈怎么聊"
- The document has 6 sections, each with a colored sidebar label and numbered questions
- Sections are: 本职工作, 领导风格, 绩效管理, 沟通理解, 部门合作, 气氛环境
- Each section has 5-6 numbered questions
- The layout is a single column with each section having a left sidebar label and content on the right

I need to:
1. Extract all text verbatim
2. Replicate the layout with the sidebar labels on the left and content on the right
3. Use appropriate styling to match the visual appearance
4. Create a clean, structured HTML document

Let me structure this with CSS grid or flexbox to create the sidebar + content layout for each section.
